_comment: PROVEN INSTRUMENTS — C2B Web Design.
One entry per verify/ script that has been PROVED to go RED. Read by
verify/run.mjs, which suppresses the pass verdict of any script not listed
here. Nothing is blocked; every script still runs.
WHY: the expensive instrument failures all failed toward a PASS.
q5-stutter.mjs read 0/3 CLEAN on a visible stall; one-context.mjs read 2/2
while a WebGL context was created per question; the reveal instrument
reported 0ms on a live freeze. A false alarm costs minutes and gets
investigated. A FALSE PASS GETS BELIEVED.
⚠ A FALSIFY FLAG IS NOT A RED RUN. 15 scripts have a falsification mode; a
mode is a capability, a run is evidence. Only a run that was actually
performed and recorded in project-intelligence/ belongs here.
TO ADD AN ENTRY: run the script against a build carrying a real or injected
defect, confirm it goes RED, revert the injection, confirm it goes green
again, and write the run up in project-intelligence/. Then add it here with
the record it came from. Do not add a script on the strength of a summary
sentence in another document — the run itself must be recorded.
"blindSpots" is what the script does NOT watch, taken from its own declared
scope. run.mjs prints these after a proven script's verdict, because a
proven instrument is still a narrow one.

proven.injected: A width-scoped defect read from app/globals.css:1940 — inside @media (max-width: 639px), .enquiry-pdepth-1 { bottom: 4.675rem } plus a 900ms bottom transition on .enquiry-phrase-anim. Result: mobile 390x844 RED at 105.58px drift (tolerance 1.5px), desktop 1440x900 GREEN at 0px, exit 1. Injection reverted; re-run confirmed green at both widths, tree byte-identical to bea8257.
proven.whyItCounts: The defect was width-scoped, so the harness had to DISCRIMINATE rather than merely react — an instrument that responds to any injected change would have failed both widths. It did not. A first, desktop-scoped falsification was rejected by Carl because its 88.78px red was the injected desktop constant, not mobile's own ladder.
blindSpots: Reads RECTS, NOT PIXELS. It would pass on a page rendering nothing at all. It is not a substitute for looking.
Says NOTHING about the fade, the 0.78 dimming, opacity of any kind, clickability, the rail's rungs, or the card entrance ladder.
Watches ONE box: .enquiry-phrase-extras. If the cards move INSIDE that box, this harness is blind to it.

proven.injected: NO INJECTION NEEDED — the honest production run goes RED on today's build, 7/8 runs, exit 1. Two further falsifications confirmed it fails the right way: the crop moved to empty sky (y=200) reported 'NO REVEAL FOUND' on all 8 rather than a misleading 0ms, and a run below the floor reported 'NO FREEZE FOUND — a finding ABOUT THIS INSTRUMENT'. Reveal window measured 1280–1320ms against the declared 1300ms, 8/8.
proven.whyItCounts: Version 3 of the window anchored on the last frame below 25% of settled brightness — an anchor that excluded the thing it measured. ⚠ WITHOUT THE REQUIRED RED ON TODAY'S BUILD IT WOULD HAVE SHIPPED AS 'THE STALL IS FIXED'. The red was the only thing that caught it.
blindSpots: Desktop 1440x900 only. Mobile is unexercised — a coverage gap, not a timing one.
Q5 only — the reveal after Begin. Not Q4–Q1, not the corridor step.
⚠ 40ms QUANTISATION. 25fps is a FLOOR on resolution: a freeze shorter than 40ms is invisible here, and every duration is bounded, not exact.
NO ATTRIBUTION. It says a freeze happened, where, and for how long. It says NOTHING about why — diagnosis is out of scope.
